title: Google, NASA launch AI model to map methane emissions from space
summary: The MAPL-EMIT model, which the tech giant and space agency introduced in a scientific journal, was tested on 25 landfills. It was able to detect 50% more methane leaks than human experts.

title: Massachusetts issues $2.8M in waste reduction grants in last month
summary: The two funding rounds address a range of materials, including food waste, textiles and plastics. More than two dozen companies, including Casella and Black Earth Compost, received grants.

title: House passes trio of waste bills, including lithium-ion battery updates
summary: Other bills focused on recovering critical materials at contaminated waste sites and updating the Solid Waste Disposal Act. They are all moving to the Senate for consideration and involve new work led by the U.S. EPA.

title: 800K tons of film, flex end markets to accelerate PCR demand: report
